name: Danny Kirrane
bio: Daniel Kirrane is an English actor. He has appeared in films such as Walking on Sunshine and Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales

Unbeknownst to Maddie, however, Raf is Taylor's ex-holiday flame, and the love of her life...
